subject: MAP: POC access checklist & target timeline
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearmind.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@clearmind.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC access checklist & target timeline

Hi Liam / Elaine —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our MAP discussion I attached a lightweight access matrix to get the POC environment live. Goal is to have the customer-facing sandbox (tenant + API keys) and IP/VPC connectivity in place so your developers can begin model evaluation the week of Oct 26. Quick asks below so we can lock dates: 

- Org setup: Please confirm the preferred org name (tenant id) and primary admin user for initial access. We will provision a Redwood tenant in your account namespace once confirmed.
- API keys: We can issue ephemeral API keys scoped to the POC. Tell us whether you want key material via secure email or DocuSign-protected link.
- IP allowlist: See attached network_allowlist_template.csv — please fill the public IPs for your egress and any transit NATs. If you want VPC peering instead, note VPC ranges and preferred peering window.
- VPC peering: If proceeding, we prefer a 1–2 hour maintenance window; provide 2 candidate windows between Oct 26–29.

Attachments: MAP_access_matrix_v1.xlsx (MAP checklist + owners), network_allowlist_template.csv (CSV template)

Proposed target timeline (subject to your confirmation):
1) By Oct 21 — org name, admin user, and chosen connectivity approach (allowlist vs peering)
2) Oct 22–23 — Redwood provisions tenant + issues POC API keys (ephemeral)
3) Oct 26 — Eng team begins evaluation (models, latency checks, smoke tests)

If procurement needs a shorter SOW or a one-page summary for internal approvals, Marissa is copied and can prepare.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

---
Attachment stubs: MAP_access_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB), network_allowlist_template.csv (CSV, 1KB)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearmind.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@clearmind.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: POC access checklist & target timeline

Thanks Stephanie — this is clear and helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Org name / admin: We want the tenant created under "clearmind-eval" and I'll designate Elaine (elaine.park@clearmind.ai) as the primary admin.
2) API keys: Procurement asks that key issuance go through DocuSign or an encrypted portal for audit reasons. DocuSign link is preferable.
3) IP vs peering: We prefer VPC peering so traffic doesn't traverse public IPs. Our infra team provided two candidate windows: Oct 27 02:00–04:00 PDT or Oct 28 18:00–20:00 PDT. 
4) VPC ranges: Clearmind VPC CIDR is 10.12.0.0/16 (dev cluster), peer with us on prefix 10.12.0.0/16.

Can you confirm whether Redwood requires any inbound ports opened for health checks or if peering alone is sufficient? Also please confirm whether ephemeral keys will be rotated automatically after the POC or if we need to run a rotation job.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if easier.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
VP Engineering, Clearmind AI
liam.oconnor@clearmind.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP: POC access checklist & target timeline

Stephanie / Marissa — forwarding Liam's reply. Short notes from infra side: 

- Health checks: For peering-only flow we do not require open public ports; we only need the peering connection and route propagation. If Clearmind wants to keep peering asymmetric (ingress only), we need to confirm return route for our egress.
- Peering prep: We need Clearmind's VPC id, account id, and the desired peer subnet (they provided 10.12.0.0/16). Also need a list of any downstream NATs that may rewrite source IPs for audit logs.
- Keys: We support DocuSign key delivery — we can stage the key material and link it behind the DocuSign envelope. Ephemeral keys will be set to 72-hour TTL by default for the POC; we can extend if needed.
- Owner assignments: I'll take point on the peering execution and schedule the peering change during the Oct 27 02:00–04:00 PDT window unless Clearmind asks for the 28th evening. Marissa — can you draft a one-page SOW for procurement that lists the peering maintenance window and our security controls?

I'll prepare the peering checklist doc and send to Liam/Elaine with the specific fields to fill (VPC id, account id, route tables).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Infrastructure Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
